summary: McBee fire tower in Chesterfield County, SC; a 1944-45 state report says it was overhauled and painted. No build date, height or current status found.

facts.status_note: No source we read says whether the tower was removed, moved or still stands.

events.note: Overhauled and painted; the state report covers 7/1/44 to 6/30/45
Statewide closure: the commission closed its last forest fire lookout towers

evidence.supports: The lookout is listed under the South Carolina Forestry Commission
The lookout is in Chesterfield County
The McBee fire tower was overhauled and painted in the 1944-45 report year
evidence.quote: 1944-45: The McBee fire tower was overhauled and painted.

evidence.supports: The state report covers July 1944 to June 1945
evidence.quote: Report of the State Commission of Forestry, 7/1/44 to 6/30/45

evidence.supports: The tower system had served the state since the 1930s

evidence.supports: The towers were gradually phased out after the commission found they mainly served as a communication network
evidence.quote: During the 1980s it became obvious that the tower system served primarily as a communication network, and the towers were gradually phased out.

evidence.supports: The commission closed the last of its forest fire lookout towers in 1993
evidence.quote: The Forestry Commission closed the last of its forest fire lookout towers on this day in 1993.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Sources are one lookout-history page with a single report line, one OpenStreetMap point, and the statewide closure post. McBee is not in the NHLR South Carolina list (37 entries) or the firetower.org former-sites list (7 entries), and the Wikipedia article on McBee has no tower entry. Brief elevation 161 m matches the OSM ele tag; brief coordinates match the OSM node. No build date, height, staffing, access or current status found, so none is stated. The brief's status 'unknown' is kept as 'unconfirmed'. No photos found.
